title: Nine hundred and four miners died in Caul Deep and were written off as repatriated
desc: Shaft One blew out on 4 April 2387. The Director had the shaft sealed at the 300-metre station, some still alive behind the seal. Teodor posted the dead as contracts bought out and repatriated, and forged 431 letters home.

title: The Throat was never in a closing phase
desc: The throat-watch's raw feed shows the Throat breathing normally. The Director's closing-phase figures were invented.

title: The Company will collapse the Throat with a throat-shear fired from the Covenant
desc: Device, Concord ordnance, class T: a Succession Wars throat-shear, bought three months before the announcement. Fired behind the Covenant as she transits, it closes the Throat for centuries and keeps the Labour Inspectorate fleet out.

title: The dead of Caul are cut on the Mercy Bell
desc: The dense band on the bell's waist, in hurried hands, is the Caul Deep roster in alphabetical order: all nine hundred and four.

title: Varga erased the Magpie's flight to Caul
desc: He watched the Magpie's unlogged run to Caul and Dagny on the comptroller's floor, and deleted both.
